content.short: Gas.zip is a gas refuel bridge that delivers native gas tokens across 350+ chains.
content.description: Gas.zip is a refuel bridge that delivers native gas to more than 350 chains in a single transaction, including Monad and Hyperliquid. A user sends once and receives gas on each selected destination, which removes the usual problem of arriving on a new chain with no way to pay fees. The service runs its own explorer and offers a LayerZero-based bridge route and testnet faucets alongside the main product.
